summary: Temporary site access and staged equipment redistribution for visiting engineer during 'Visit Week' — legacy laptop retrieval and desk setup
description: Issue summary: A visiting engineer (contractor) will be on-site for Visit Week (2026-03-16 to 2026-03-19). They require a temporary badge, a preconfigured hotdesk with dual-monitor arms, and a legacy company laptop (asset tag LTP-08432) returned to IT inventory after use. Impact: Without coordination the visitor cannot work effectively and IT will not recover the legacy asset for secure disposal. Location: Redwood HQ, 4th floor, Hotdesks cluster B (near meeting room B3). Requested actions: 1) Issue time-limited (one-week) badge and add to guest-access list with level "contractor-hybrid"; 2) Stage a hotdesk with monitor arms and docking cable available by 08:30 on 2026-03-16; 3) Arrange courier pickup for legacy laptop on 2026-03-20 to be shipped to IT asset center (secure packaging) with return tracking; 4) IT to create image for temporary laptop use and confirm laptop serial & encryption status. Acceptance criteria: badge issued and tested before arrival, desk staged and photographed, laptop picked up and scanned into IT inventory within 2 business days of pickup. Special instructions: laptop contains legacy data — IT must perform secure wipe after imaging and record EOL disposition. Primary contact: Liam O'Connor (reporter) mobile: +1-415-555-0123. Backup contact: Facilities on-call (Slack #facilities-ops).
comments: 2026-03-10 — Liam O'Connor: Opening ticket — scheduling Visit Week logistics. Need temporary badge and desk setup for visiting contractor; legacy laptop must be retrieved after visit.

2026-03-10 — Priya Shah (Facilities): Confirmed we can provision a temporary contractor badge. Need full name, photo ID, and expected arrival time to create hotspot pass. Also requesting monitor arm SKU and desk preferences.

2026-03-11 — IT Asset Team (Raj Patel): Confirmed asset LTP-08432 serial GZ-9932 exists in inventory as 'decommissioned-in-place'. We need physical handoff or courier chain-of-custody to accept return. Will prepare wipe/imaging plan.

2026-03-11 — Shipping Coordinator (Monica Lee): Scheduled courier pickup window for 2026-03-20 10:00-14:00. Provided pre-paid label template; will print and attach at pickup if Facilities hands package to courier.
investigation_notes: Checked badge history for visitor email (contractor@example.com): no active passes in the last 24 months — requires new temporary badge.
Hotdesk B cluster: monitor arms inventory shows 2 in stock (SKU MA-120). Nearest spare dock cables located in IT closet C4.
Asset LTP-08432: last recorded status 'decommissioned-in-place' (2025-10-02). No active encryption exception on record. IT to verify BitLocker status on handoff.
Courier options compared: SecureShip (preferred) supports chain-of-custody and insured transport; estimated pickup lead time 2 business days from request approval.
resolution: Temporary badge pre-provisioned on 2026-03-12 and QR check-in code emailed to reporter. Hotdesk B04 staged with two monitor arms and dock cable; photos attached to ticket (link in Confluence runbook). Courier booked with SecureShip for 2026-03-20 10:00-14:00; Facilities to drop packaged legacy laptop at lobby if visitor hands it to Facilities on 2026-03-19. IT asset team to image and securely wipe device, then update inventory disposition to 'recycled' by 2026-03-24. Follow-up action: add a one-click Visit Week checklist to Confluence to streamline future requests (owner: Priya Shah).
